bridge_chains.name: SDP_to_certification_pipeline
bridge_chains.description: ML explores → SDP refines → Grunsky encodes → interval arithmetic certifies → rigorous bound on B_u. This chain converts heuristic numerical exploration into machine-checkable mathematical proof.

bridge_chains.name: stochastic_to_extremal_domains
bridge_chains.description: SLE provides probabilistic intuition → Loewner energy quantifies complexity → welding encodes boundary → harmonic symmetry constrains arc placement → Polya-Chebotarev determines minimal capacity. This chain connects random geometry to classical extremal problems.

bridge_chains.name: geometry_to_analysis_bridge
bridge_chains.description: Spectral bounds constrain geometry → OT quantifies domain distortion → variational methods optimize arc removal → harmonic symmetry emerges → B_u is bounded. This chain uses modern geometric analysis to attack a classical function theory problem.

bridge_chains.name: algebra_to_optimization
bridge_chains.description: Tropical geometry reveals combinatorial skeleton → Polya-Chebotarev gives analytic structure → quadratic differentials encode extremality → SDP relaxation computes bounds → B_u is determined. Algebra informs the structure that optimization exploits.
